ai_language_tip: Speak polite Urdu (ur) with 'aap'; mixing in English words (booking, appointment, order) is normal; switch to English at hotels, hospitals and corporate lines if staff prefers; owners often text in Roman Urdu on WhatsApp; Punjabi, Sindhi and Pashto speakers usually also understand Urdu.
english_ok: sometimes — Widely used by hotels, private hospitals, banks and offices in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad; limited at small shops, mechanics and in smaller towns.
politeness: Open with 'Assalam-o-alaikum', use 'aap' and 'ji' ('haan ji'); 'sahab'/'bhai' for men and 'baji'/'madam' for women; mention you are calling on behalf of someone; close with 'shukriya, Allah Hafiz'.
name_tip: Give the full name as written on the booking; patients are often booked by name and age; women's bookings at parlours and clinics are commonly under the woman's own name, not a male relative's; spell English letters for chain/hotel bookings.
phone_tip: Mobile 03XX 123 4567 style (11 digits starting 03; +92 drops the 0); landline 042 1234 5678 (city code); businesses usually run on WhatsApp on the same mobile; SMS for confirmations.
time_tip: CRITICAL: 'ساڑھے سات' = 7:30, 'سوا سات' = 7:15, 'پونے آٹھ' = 7:45, 'ڈیڑھ' = 1:30, 'ڈھائی' = 2:30; no AM/PM, so day-part words (صبح/دوپہر/شام/رات) decide it; dinner at 21:00–22:00 is normal; read back with the day part.
number_tip: Urdu numbers 1–100 are irregular words; 'ڈیڑھ' = 1.5 and 'ڈھائی' = 2.5 (time and money); prices often in 'hazaar' (thousand) and 'lakh' (100,000); read phone numbers in groups (03XX 123 4567).
avoid_calling: Avoid Friday Jumma prayer break (about 13:00–14:30), Ramadan iftar time and the hour after, restaurant peaks 13:30–15:00 and 21:00–23:00 (dinner runs late), and calls before 10:00 to shops, which open late.
closed_days: Federal government offices close Sat–Sun; provinces and private firms vary; markets in big cities each have a weekly closed day (varies by city and market); Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-ul-Adha bring several closed days; Muharram 9–10 (Ashura) closures.
booking_channels: Doctors via oladoc and Marham (both also book by helpline) or the clinic receptionist; food via foodpanda; rides via Careem, inDrive, Bykea and Yango; shopping on Daraz and Instagram/Facebook pages with cash on delivery; payments by JazzCash, Easypaisa or bank transfer.
voice_menu: Telecoms (Jazz, Zong, Telenor/Ufone), banks, JazzCash/Easypaisa, NADRA and airlines use Urdu/English IVR; clinics, shops and restaurants are usually answered by a person.
callback_habits: Shops and service providers commonly reply or confirm by WhatsApp voice note or message from a mobile; oladoc/Marham confirm by SMS; couriers (TCS, Leopards) phone before delivery.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 室內運動場（futsal、板球網場）、遊樂設施與農場度假屋（farmhouse）常可電話或 WhatsApp 預訂時段，週末與假日需提早。

may_come_up.what: Futsal or farmhouse slot needs advance to secure it
Amusement park tickets sold only at the gate

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full advance to a personal wallet before confirming

usually_asked: Date and time slot (often night slots)

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 女性美容院（parlour）與男士理髮店多可電話或 WhatsApp 約，新娘妝與 Eid 前檔期緊張且常收訂金。

may_come_up.what: Bridal or mehndi-night makeup needs an advance and date lock
Gents' barbers take walk-ins without booking

sensitive_asked.what: Requests advance to an unverified personal wallet number

usually_asked: Service (haircut, facial, threading, waxing, bridal, mehndi)

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消直接打給店家或診所櫃台；oladoc 預約可在 App 內於 24 小時前改期；訂金通常不退。

may_come_up.what: Advance for an event is non-refundable
oladoc allows rescheduling up to 24 hours before

sensitive_asked.what: Asks transaction ID of the JazzCash/Easypaisa advance

usually_asked: Name and mobile on the booking
Booking ID if via oladoc or Marham

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 醫師多在私人診所傍晚至夜間看診，櫃台以電話登記時段或號碼；也可透過 oladoc、Marham 網站或熱線代約，oladoc 預約可在 24 小時前改期或取消。

may_come_up.what: Receptionist gives a token number for the evening clinic
Doctor not sitting that day; receptionist offers another evening

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CNIC number or previous reports in detail

usually_asked: Which doctor and which clinic or hospital

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、電力（DISCO）與錢包客服有 IVR 且須本人核身，代理人多只能問一般資訊。

may_come_up.what: Bank or telco serves only the account holder

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CNIC number, PIN, OTP or account number

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 身分證（CNIC）換發、修改與補發可用 NADRA 的 Pak ID App 線上辦，新辦須到場；聯邦機關週一至週四有午間禮拜休息，週五午休較長。

may_come_up.what: CNIC renewal can be done in the Pak ID app; new cards need a NADRA visit

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、冷氣、太陽能與搬家師傅多靠電話或 WhatsApp，地址需含街道／區塊（block/sector/phase）與地標；常先到場估價。

may_come_up.what: Technician charges a visit fee
Solar or UPS work quoted only after inspection

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full advance to a personal wallet

usually_asked: Full address with block/sector/phase and landmark

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店與北部山區賓館（guest house）電話與 WhatsApp 訂房普遍，旺季（夏季北部、假日）要求訂金；入住須出示 CNIC 或護照。

may_come_up.what: Guest house in the northern areas needs an advance in summer
CNIC or passport required at check-in

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card details or CNIC copy by phone

usually_asked: Guests, family or not, and room type

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問營業時間、價格、庫存，電話與 WhatsApp 都很常見；市場有每週公休日，各市各市場不同。

may_come_up.what: Shop gives price or timings directly by phone
Says which weekday the market is closed

pet.before_dialing_zh: 寵物診所多在大城市，可電話預約；常問貓、狗或鳥類與疫苗紀錄。

may_come_up.what: Vet clinic asks for the vaccination card

sensitive_asked.what: Asks payment for a home visit in advance

usually_asked: Animal kind (cat, dog, bird), breed and age

property.before_dialing_zh: 租售屋多透過 Zameen.com 等平台或房仲（property dealer）電話聯繫，看房常需當天約時間。

may_come_up.what: Dealer commission and months of advance rent

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CNIC copy or job details for police verification

repair.before_dialing_zh: 汽機車修理廠與手機電器維修多為直接到店，電話用來問價與零件；授權車廠可電話約保養。

may_come_up.what: Mechanic gives the price only after inspection
Authorised dealer books periodic service by phone

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to pay for parts in advance to a personal number

usually_asked: Vehicle or device make and model
Registration number for cars and bikes

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 中高價與 BBQ 餐廳常可電話訂位，家庭區（family hall）與一般區分開；齋戒月開齋（iftar）自助餐與週末晚間要提早訂，常要先付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Dhaba-style places say walk-in only, no reservations
Iftar buffet seats need advance payment per head
Large family gathering asked to choose a set menu (per-head deal)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks JazzCash/Easypaisa prepayment to a personal number for a small table

usually_asked: Date and time, dinner usually after 20:00
Iftar buffet or à la carte

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 糕餅、甜點（mithai）與小店接受電話或 WhatsApp 訂貨，常用貨到付款；客製蛋糕需提前並付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Custom cake or mithai box order needs advance

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full prepayment to an unknown wallet number

usually_asked: Item and quantity (kg of mithai, cake pounds)
Pickup or home delivery, cash on delivery

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外帶外送多用 foodpanda，許多餐廳也直接電話接單外送或自取；尖峰時段電話常忙線。

may_come_up.what: Restaurant asks to order on foodpanda instead
Own delivery has a minimum order and delivery charge

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to share an app OTP

tracking.before_dialing_zh: TCS、Leopards、M&P 與 Pakistan Post 查件以追蹤碼在官網或 App 處理，電話客服常塞線；建議改用官網追蹤或 WhatsApp 客服。

may_come_up.what: Courier site gives status from the tracking number

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the delivery OTP or CNIC

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車多用 Careem、inDrive、Yango 與機車載客 Bykea；城際巴士與包車可電話預約。

may_come_up.what: Suggests booking through Careem or inDrive
Intercity coach seat needs CNIC at booking

sensitive_asked.what: Asks CNIC number for the passenger list
